Faq.title:
Questions people
actually ask us.
Faq.subtitle: Organized by what you're wondering, not by department.

whatIs.question: What is Heartfolio?
whatIs.answer: Heartfolio makes personalized digital gifts — keepsakes built from your own dates, places and words, then delivered as high-resolution files you download the moment you've paid. Most people buy them as anniversary or wedding gifts for a partner, and print them to frame. Nothing is shipped and nothing keeps you waiting.

preview.question: Will it actually look like the preview?
preview.answer: Yes — what you see while creating is a true render of your keepsake, not a placeholder mockup. What arrives is what you saw.

printing.question: Can I get this printed and framed?
printing.answer: Yes — your download includes print-ready PNG and PDF files at 300 DPI, ready for any local or online print shop. Most shops prefer the PDF. Ask for museum or archival paper if you'd like it to last.

sizing.question: What size can I print this at?
sizing.answer: Every printable version comes in three sizes: A4, which also prints as A3; Classic 8″ × 10″, which scales to 16″ × 20″; and Poster 12″ × 18″, which scales to 24″ × 36″. Each is its own file built for that shape, so nothing gets cropped to fit.

mistake.question: Can I fix a mistake after ordering?
mistake.answer: Almost always, yes. You can adjust the date, the words, or a spelling as many times as you like before you buy — nothing is final until you download it.

access.question: How long can I access my files?
access.answer: Your files stay available — the photos you uploaded are kept, and your keepsake is regenerated whenever you need it. The link in your receipt email works on any device for 30 days. If it ever stops working, just reply to that email and we will send you a fresh one.

incomplete.question: What if I don't know the exact time or location?
incomplete.answer: That's alright. An approximate time still produces something beautiful and accurate, and we'll gently guide you if something's missing.

appropriate.question: Is this appropriate as a gift for a wedding, a birth, or a loss?
appropriate.answer: It's made for exactly those moments. Each occasion has its own tone — a memorial print is treated with the same care whether it's your first order or your fiftieth.

memorialNote.title: For memorial and sympathy orders
memorialNote.text: If any detail is missing or uncertain, we'll reach out gently, once, and never rush you for an answer. There is no upsell on this page, and there never will be.

songPoster.storyTitle: A song, seen instead of heard.
songPoster.story: Every song deserves a shape. A Song Poster gives yours one — a soundwave designed for your order — and sets it with the title, the artist and the moment it belongs to. It reads as artwork first and as a memory second, which is exactly the right order.

audience.title: Who it's for
audience.body: Anyone with a song that belongs to someone: a couple's first dance, the lullaby a parent still hums, the track a friend always puts on for the drive home. All you need is the song's YouTube link, a photo and, if you like, a few words of dedication. Pick one of eight styles and the design is done for you.

faq.question: Which songs can I use?
faq.answer: Any song with a YouTube link: you give its title, artist and link, and we check the video is available. The soundwave is designed for your order, not taken from the recording. No audio is sold, included or distributed.

faq.question: Can I add my own words?
faq.answer: Yes. A short dedication — a date, a lyric fragment, a name — is part of the personalization.

faq.question: Will it look good in a frame?
faq.answer: It is designed for paper first. The printable edition is prepared at 300 DPI with the proportions standard frames expect.

whereWeMet.story: Coordinates are unromantic until they are yours. Where We Met takes the exact spot — the corner, the bar, the bridge, the address you both still call 'the flat' — and draws its streets in fine linework, with a single mark where you stood and the coordinates set underneath.

faq.question: How specific can the location be?
faq.answer: As specific as an address or a dropped pin. The map is drawn around the coordinates you give us.

faq.question: Can I mark more than one place?
faq.answer: Each map centres on one place, which is what keeps it calm. For several moments, the Love Story Timeline is the better fit.

faq.question: Is the map real?
faq.answer: Yes — real street geometry for that location, redrawn in Heartfolio's style rather than a screenshot.

loveStoryTimeline.storyTitle: One line, five moments, a whole story.
loveStoryTimeline.story: Most relationships are remembered as a handful of dates that mean nothing to anyone else. The Love Story Timeline puts three to five of them on a single line — the day you met, the day you moved, the day you decided — each with its own photo and short caption, laid out so it reads as one continuous story rather than a list.

faq.question: How many moments can I include?
faq.answer: Between three and five. Fewer than three isn't a timeline. Four or five is where most stories sit comfortably.

faq.question: Can I use photos?
faq.answer: Yes — and each milestone needs one. The photographs are what carry every one of the six layouts, so a timeline is built around them rather than decorated with them.

faq.question: How do I receive it?
faq.answer: Instantly, as a download. Nothing is shipped and nothing is printed for you — the moment your payment clears, your keepsake is ready to open, and the print-ready file is there too if you chose a version that includes one.

digital.description: Your personalized digital keepsake experience — the story laid out exactly as you built it, ready to revisit anytime.

audience.title: Who it's for
audience.body: This one is made for couples, families, parents, and anyone making a story for someone else. What it needs is a shared history long enough to have a few dates that matter. You don't need to be a designer or know what you want before you start: you bring the dates, the photos and the words, and the layout is already decided.

reasonsILoveYou.storyTitle: Some things are easier to say one at a time.
reasonsILoveYou.story: You write the reasons (the way they laugh, the songs they get wrong, the thing they did without being asked) and choose how they are given. Each tap opens one. When the last is read, a final message appears and your signature writes itself, followed by a letter if you want to say more.

faq.question: How many reasons can I write?
faq.answer: Between one and ten. Each can have a photo and a short memory line under it.

faq.question: What are the four gifts?
faq.answer: A jar of notes, a daisy picked petal by petal, a deck of hearts drawn card by card, and a plate of fortune cookies. Each has its own look, its own fonts and its own little tune, played live as they open it.

graduationKeepsake.storyTitle: Everything that got them here, in one place.
graduationKeepsake.story: You gather the photos from the first day of school to the cap and gown, the achievements worth celebrating, and the messages from the people who were there (written, drawn or recorded). Then you choose the journey: they tear a boarding pass, count down a launch, press start, cut a ribbon or begin a climb, and the story unfolds as they go.

faq.question: What are the five journeys?
faq.answer: Next Chapter Airways (a flight), Mission: Graduation (a space launch), Level Complete (an arcade game), The Retrospective (a gallery opening) and The Summit (a mountain climb). Each has its own opening, look, words, finale and sound effects.

faq.question: Can family and friends add voice messages?
faq.answer: Yes: up to five in one keepsake, each up to a minute. Record them in the Studio, or upload the ones people sent you on WhatsApp or from an iPhone. You can add a caption to each, and up to five drawings too.

faq.question: What can I leave out?
faq.answer: The path through the years, the achievements, the messages, the goals and the letter can each be switched off. Only the graduate's details and the final line are always there.

faq.question: How do they receive it?
faq.answer: As a private link, the moment your payment clears. There is no file to print or frame: you send them the link, or give them the QR card that comes with it.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Heartfolio collects, uses and protects your personal information.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what Heartfolio collects when you make or receive a keepsake, why, who handles it for us, and how long we keep it. The business responsible for your data (the "controller") is {controller}.

sections.title: What we collect
body: What you put into a keepsake: names, dates, places, messages and the other details you type; photos and drawings you upload; voice notes and recordings you add; for Song Poster, the YouTube link of your song.
Your email address, to deliver your order and answer you.
Order details: what you bought, the price, and Freemius's payment reference. We never receive your card details.
Technical data: your IP address and browser details reach our servers with every request and are kept briefly in server logs.
Messages: what you tell us in feedback or when you write to us.

sections.title: How we use it
body: To make, store and deliver your keepsake and the Digital page you share.
To send your receipt and order link, and to answer support requests.
To keep the service secure and working, for example by limiting how many requests can be made in a short time.
Only with your consent, to measure how the site is used (Google Analytics).
We do not sell your data and do not use your content for advertising.

sections.title: Who can see a Digital keepsake
body: A Digital keepsake page is unlisted: anyone who has its link or QR card can open it and see what you put in it.

sections.title: Services that handle data for us
body: Freemius: payment, sales tax and receipts. As merchant of record it also processes your data under its own privacy policy.
Supabase: our database (orders, drafts, the text of your keepsake).
Cloudflare R2: storage for photos, drawings and recordings.
Resend: sends our emails.
Telegram: internal notifications to us about orders and support. These include an order reference and, for some alerts, the customer's email address.
Mapbox: place search in the Studio. What you type into a location field is sent to Mapbox to suggest places.

YouTube (Google): for Song Poster we check your link with YouTube, and the Digital page plays the song in YouTube's player, in its privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com). YouTube says that mode stores no information about a visitor until the song is played; once it plays, Google's privacy policy applies and the player may set its own cookies.
Google Analytics: only if you accept analytics in the cookie banner.
Our hosting provider, {hosting}: runs the servers the site is served from.
Some of these providers process data outside your country, including in the United States, under their own safeguards.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
body: Always used, because the site needs them: a session cookie that keeps your draft and order together, for 30 days; a security cookie that protects forms; and your language choice, for one year.
Your light/dark preference and your cookie choice are saved in your browser's storage.

Only if you accept: Google Analytics cookies, which measure visits. Choosing "No thanks" keeps them off, and the site works the same either way. To change your choice later, use "Cookie settings" at the foot of any page.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: A paid keepsake (its details, photos, drawings and recordings): for as long as your keepsake is online, so your files can be downloaded again and your Digital page keeps working.
Voice notes and recordings that never become part of a paid order: deleted automatically 7 days after upload.
Drafts you did not buy, with their photos and recordings: deleted after 12 months without activity.
Order records: for as long as tax and accounting law requires.
Server logs: rotated automatically and kept only for a short time.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask us for a copy of your data, to correct it, to delete it, or to object to how we use it, by writing to {email}. Deleting a paid keepsake's content also takes its Digital page offline and makes its files unavailable. We keep the order records the law requires us to keep.
If you are in the EU or the UK, you can also complain to your data protection authority.

sections.title: Children
body: Heartfolio is for adults. If you include a child in a keepsake, for example a graduation, make sure you have their parent's or guardian's permission.

sections.title: Contact and changes
body: Questions about privacy can be sent to {email}. If we change this policy, the new version is published here with its date.

meta.title: Terms & Conditions
meta.description: The terms that apply when you buy a personalized digital keepsake from Heartfolio.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply when you create and buy a keepsake on Heartfolio (theheartfolio.com). They explain what you receive, how payment works, and what each of us is responsible for. Heartfolio is run by {controller}.

sections.title: What you buy
body: Heartfolio makes personalized digital keepsakes from the details you enter in our Studio. Nothing physical is made, printed or posted, and printing and framing are not included in any price.

Depending on the keepsake, you can buy: Printable, high-resolution print files (PNG and PDF, in several sizes) to download and print wherever you like; Digital, a private web page made for the gift, opened from a link or the QR card we give you; or Printable + Digital, both together at a combined price.
Reasons I Love You and Graduation Keepsake are Digital only.
Each keepsake is made from your details, so no two are the same. What the Studio preview shows is what we deliver; printed colours can vary slightly with the printer and paper.

sections.title: Prices and payment
body: Prices are shown in US dollars (USD). Your bank may add its own exchange fees.

Payments are processed by Freemius, which acts as our reseller and merchant of record: Freemius sells the keepsake to you, takes the payment, handles any sales tax and issues the receipt for the transaction, under its own terms. We never see or store your card details.

sections.title: Delivery
body: Your keepsake is delivered as soon as your payment is confirmed. Your order page and the receipt email give you the files to download (Printable) and the link and QR card for the gift's page (Digital).
The link in your receipt email works for 30 days. If it stops working, write to {email} and we will send a fresh one. Your files and your Digital page do not expire with the link.
Your keepsake is final once you pay: its details cannot be edited after purchase, so check the preview before you buy.

sections.title: Your Digital keepsake
body: A Digital keepsake is a private page at an unlisted address. Anyone with its link or QR card can open it, and search engines are asked not to list it. Share it only with the people you mean to.
We keep Digital keepsake pages online for as long as Heartfolio operates. If that ever has to change, we will email you at least 30 days before.

Song Poster plays your song from the YouTube link you choose, in YouTube's own player. We do not supply or license the music, and the song stops playing if its owner removes it from YouTube. The soundwave on your poster is designed for your order; it is not taken from the recording.

sections.title: Your content
body: What you put into your keepsake stays yours. You confirm that you have the right to use every photo, drawing, recording, name and message you add, and the permission of the people in them (a parent's or guardian's for a child).
Do not add anything unlawful, hateful, or that infringes someone else's rights. We may take down a Digital keepsake page that does, without a refund.
You allow us to store and process your content only to make, deliver and support your keepsake. We do not use it for advertising and do not show it to anyone else.

sections.title: Using your keepsake
body: Your keepsake is for personal use: print it, display it, give it as a gift and share its link. Reselling Heartfolio designs, or offering them as your own product, is not allowed.

sections.title: Refunds
body: Refunds are covered by our Refund Policy.

sections.title: Our responsibility
body: We do our best to keep Heartfolio available and your keepsake correct. If something goes wrong on our side, our responsibility is to fix or re-issue your keepsake, or to refund what you paid for it. Nothing in these terms limits the rights you have under the consumer law where you live.

sections.title: Changes and contact
body: We may update these terms. The version in force when you bought applies to your purchase. Questions about these terms can be sent to {email}.

meta.title: Refund Policy
meta.description: How refunds work for Heartfolio's personalized digital keepsakes.

refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.intro: Every keepsake is made from your details and delivered the moment you pay, so we cannot take it back the way a shop takes back a parcel. What we can promise is that you will never be left with a keepsake that does not work.

sections.title: Before you buy
body: The Studio shows you exactly what you will receive. Change any detail as often as you like and check the preview carefully: a keepsake cannot be edited after purchase.

sections.title: Our policy
body: Once your keepsake has been delivered (your files are ready to download, or your Digital page is live, which happens as soon as payment is confirmed), we do not refund a change of mind.

We do put it right if your keepsake is broken or not as described: the files will not download or will not open, the Digital page does not work, what we produced does not match what your preview showed, or you were charged twice.

sections.title: How to ask: within 14 days
body: Write to {email} within 14 days of your purchase, from the email address you used or with your order reference, and tell us what is wrong. A screenshot helps but is not required. We answer every request.
We will first try to fix your keepsake or re-issue it. If we cannot, we refund you in full, to the card or account you paid with.

sections.title: Payments through Freemius
body: Freemius is the reseller and merchant of record for every purchase, so refunds are issued through Freemius. Please write to us first rather than opening a dispute with your bank: we can usually sort it out quickly.

sections.title: Your legal rights
body: By completing your purchase, you ask us to deliver your digital keepsake immediately, and you acknowledge that the right to cancel a purchase of digital content ends once delivery has started, where the law allows this. Any other rights you have under the consumer law where you live are unaffected.

meta.title: Contact & Support
meta.description: Get help with a Heartfolio order, download, personalization detail or refund.

contact.title: Contact & Support
contact.intro: Whatever the question, it goes to the same place: {email}. There is no ticket queue to navigate and no phone tree.

sections.title: A problem with a purchase
body: Charged twice, charged an unexpected amount, or no confirmation arrived? Send us the email address you used and roughly when it happened, and we will trace it.

sections.title: A problem with a download
body: If a file will not download or will not open, tell us which keepsake and which device. We can re-issue your files.

sections.title: A personalization detail is wrong
body: A misspelled name, the wrong date, a caption that reads oddly — send us the correction. If the mistake is ours we will fix and re-issue it at no cost.

sections.title: Refunds
body: Refund questions are handled by email too. Our Refund Policy explains what we can do and when.

sections.title: Everything else
body: Ideas, requests for a keepsake we do not make yet, or press enquiries — the same address reaches us: {email}.
